screenshots.title: What you'll actually use.
screenshots.description: Real screens from the app — from the home screen to a finished PDF.

items.title: Your home base
items.body: Scan, import photos, or make a folder. Recent work is right there when you come back.

items.title: Point and scan
items.body: See the page outline while you aim. Hold steady and Scanly can capture for you — or use the shutter.

items.title: Fix the page
items.body: Crop, pick a filter, and tweak brightness or contrast until the page looks right.

items.title: Many pages, one document
items.body: Portrait page tiles with a page number. Tap to review; long-press to reorder before you export.

items.title: Find it later
items.body: Search document names or words recognized on scanned pages, then open the matching page and excerpt.

items.title: Handy extras
items.body: QR codes and offline PDF tools — merge, compress, password, watermark, sign, and PDF to images — sit next to scanning. Open PDFs from other apps straight into Scanly.

items.title: Export your way
items.body: Password, page numbers, paper size — set it, then generate the PDF.

features.title: The tools you need, nothing you don't.
features.description: Everyday scanning for receipts, forms, notes, and homework — kept simple and private.

items.title: Live edges and auto-capture
items.body: See the page as you aim. Auto-capture when it's steady, or take the shot yourself.

items.title: Camera or gallery
items.body: Scan live or import photos you already have. Same editing tools either way.

items.title: Filters that help
items.body: Try Auto, Magic Color, Natural, Vivid, Screen, grayscale, and more — they stay connected to the page you captured.

items.title: Edit without worry
items.body: Your original photo stays safe. Crop and filters can always be redone.

items.title: Documents and folders
items.body: Stack pages into one file, put work in folders, search page text, and jump back from Home.

items.title: Export and share
items.body: Signed PDFs, image ZIPs, merged collections — save or share through the apps you already use.

development.title: Search scans, sign documents, meet Pip.
development.description: Find words inside scanned pages, sign PDFs or scans with reusable signatures, and get a little help from Pip — all on your device.

items.title: Find words inside scans
items.body: Bundled ML Kit text recognition runs on-device; search results include the matching page and excerpt.

items.title: Read and correct extracted text
items.body: Read recognized text, inspect its position on the scan, then copy, share, or correct it for future searches.

items.title: Sign PDFs
items.body: Place signatures, initials, dates, text, and checkboxes on a PDF, then save or share a new signed copy.

items.title: Sign scanned pages
items.body: Add editable marks to a Scanly document; they remain in previews and exports through crop, filter, and retake edits.

items.title: Reuse your signatures
items.body: Draw a signature or initials, or import a photo and extract its ink. Saved marks stay on this device.

items.title: Meet Pip
items.body: Scanly's pixel helper cheers up empty screens, coaches you while you aim the camera, and leaves one short tip a day. Turn any of it off in Settings.

items.title: Open PDFs from anywhere
items.body: Choose Open in Scanly from Files, mail, or chat apps, then sign, compress, watermark, or turn pages into images from the reader's menu.

items.title: A simpler Storage screen
items.body: Clear temporary exports, manage the save location, and tidy the library. Library backup and restore have been removed.

stats.label: where it runs
stats.note: Scanning and editing don't need the internet or a cloud account.

stats.label: where files live
stats.note: Your library stays on the device until you export or share.

stats.label: how you share
stats.note: PDFs, image ZIPs, and normal Android share sheets.

stats.label: the license
stats.note: Full source on GitHub if you want to build or contribute.
